title: Propositional Logic in Intuitionistic Primitive Recursive Arithmetic

pdf.visual_review: All 51 pages reviewed through contact sheets, with representative full-page review; revised pages 32–40 rechecked after final pagination polish. No remaining layout issues found.

mathematics.status: Developed non-formalized constructive proofs, with explicit finite encodings, primitive recursive bounds, and quantified arithmetic formulations. Not kernel verification.
reviews: Arithmetic base and Boolean syntax/proof constructors reviewed; bounded quantifiers are compiled to PR bits before induction.
Classical algorithm chapter reviewed, including Tseitin bounds, resolution completeness, 2-SAT assignment order, and finite interpolation.
IPC finite saturation reviewed with explicit derived cut and weakening; canonical-prime extension and forcing truth lemma avoid assuming cut elimination.
Curry–Howard binding/discharge conventions and SK contextual reductions reviewed.
Complexity proof reviewed with exact witness lengths, fixed-machine local transitions, boundary padding, and both SAT witness maps.
Negative translations and compactness boundary reviewed; no infinite-path existence or arithmetic self-consistency claim is made.
scope_notes: The 64 numbered entries include the compactness-to-path finite reduction and external scope comparison.
Boolean algebra universal mapping property is proved for explicitly supplied finite targets.
Minimum prime covers use primitive recursive or supplied finite costs; a global DNF minimum uses the stated monotone costs.
The IPC expanded tree bound retains derived cut. Classical LK cut elimination is proved separately by semantic reconstruction.
